subject: English
question_text: Change the sentences according to directions. 1  10 =
stimulus: (a) Very few conquerors of the world were so great as Taimur. (Superlative) (b) The province of a powerful prince was once attacked by young Taimur. (Active) (c) Entering the kingdom of the prince, he captured a large village. (Compound) (d) The army killed Taimur's all soldiers. (Passive) (e) He disguised himself as a poor traveller to survive. (Complex) (f) He came to a house and asked for something to eat. (Simple) (g) There lived an old woman in the house. (Complex) (h) The woman became sympathetic to see Taimur. (Interrogative) (i) The food was very hot. (Exclamatory) (j) Taimur was too hungry to wait. (Negative)
